title: It's a lot smaller than I expected but looks okay.
text: It's a lot smaller than I expected but looks okay.. It's wayyy smaller than what I was expecting I guess I should've measure the one I already had, it is literally smaller than my older one and my older one is already pretty small so I don't know I am not returning it though looks well built and made from good material, it was very easy to assemble and definitely works well, I am not a fan of the top part though since it feels a little cheap and flimsy but overall it's alright, I just wish it was slightly taller.
